status: Locally verified; released on 2026-11-07. Original measurements below are local; production results are in release-2026-11-07.json.

environment.geometry: Vite production preview on 127.0.0.1:4173, same synthetic blank resume before and after rebuild
environment.faultInjection: Vite development server on 127.0.0.1:5174; API requests intercepted for cloud state and account tests
environment.fixture: Default double column, standard density, no photo

geometry.inputCountingRule: Visible input, select and button[role=switch]; excludes palette, density and reset buttons. Visibility does not require intersection with viewport.

observedMouseActivationPaths.definition: Excludes typing and scrolling; records the UI path, not measured human completion time

regressionsFoundDuringVerification: Captured cloud account after awaited storage read; fixed by preserving and asserting click-time scope.
Notice state transition removed its open modal; fixed by retaining the modal while open.
Production dropdown close restored focus over the newly duplicated field; fixed by coordinating the menu close focus event.
An older narrow-container rule hid the module layout icon after its text was collapsed; added a scoped icon visibility override.
limitations: Geometry and UI interaction verification, not latency or public-network benchmarks.
Cloud presentation and race tests use injected state and intercepted APIs; no real account upload was validated.
Local auth/me has no running proxy backend; its expected errors are not counted as successful cloud integration.
Stage 4 export, cold/warm cache and slow-network acceptance remains pending.
Existing build warnings for mixed static/dynamic fflate and html.ts imports remain.
